name: SILK
oneLiner: SILK is Shade Protocol's basket-pegged stable on Secret Network, tracking a GDP-weighted currency basket and overcollateralized through ShadeLend CDP vaults.
collateral: DAO-whitelisted assets locked in overcollateralized ShadeLend vaults; current collateral identities, balances, and weights are private on Secret Network
pegMechanism: NAV tracks a governance-set basket of global currencies and commodities (currently USD ~33.5%, EUR ~22.9%, Gold ~18.7%, JPY ~11.1%, CAD ~7.5%, BTC ~6.3%) priced via Band Protocol feeds, with weights selected on GDP, monetary-policy health and growth and adjustable through SILK Assembly peg migrations; stability maintained via overcollateralized ShadeLend minting, bounded conversion minting, redemption pools, collateral redemptions/liquidations, and ShadeDAO bonds

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Shade's primary SILK documentation describes overcollateralized minting through collateralized lending, collateral redemptions against at-risk lending positions, and liquidation incentives. SILK's basket reference is not a fiat issuer reserve claim; its stabilization boundary is an advanced collateralized debt mechanism, so cdp is retained.

oracleRisk.summary: ShadeLend runs 19 registered CDP vaults across two registries (14 current, 5 legacy-deprecated), all priced through the Shade Oracle Router Primary with a single default provider (Band Standard Reference Proxy) plus collateral-family derivative oracles; the router's deviation-guard list is empty and no failover provider exists (SupraOracles remains under research). The dominant debt branch (WETH vault, 74.9% of 207,123.4 SILK aggregate elastic debt) is Band-fresh, but the second-largest (WBTC vault, 18.3%) is frozen with its staleness check disabled, near-zero remaining collateral, and a liquidation query that reverts; the Persistence stkATOM vault's oracle has rejected queries as stale since 2025-02-07 and the Stride stINJ rate since 2026-07-29. Per-vault parameters (max_ltv 45-85%, liquidation discounts 5-10%, 600s collateral staleness tolerance), debt figures, and feed freshness were read directly from the registries, router, derivative oracles, Stability Pool, and Silk Index Oracle at Secret Network block 26592283 (2026-08-08); per-position amounts remain private state. Collateral-to-quote-symbol mapping follows the Stability Pool valid-assets registry, the protocol's own mapping.

branchApplicability.rationale: ShadeLend is an isolated-risk multi-market CDP: the current Single Vault Registry returned 14 vaults and the legacy registry 5 (deprecated, still liquidatable) by compute query at block 26592283, each with its own collateral token, max_ltv, liquidation discount, and oracle staleness tolerance. Every registered vault is authored as a branch below except the legacy USDT vault (zero debt, zero remaining borrowing power, minting closed). Per-branch elastic debt shares were measured from registry debt.elastic values at block 26592283; the zero-debt branches are included with debtSharePct 0 because their normal status permits new borrowing at any time. This supersedes the 2026-07-30 unresolved disposition: the vault inventory and parameters turned out to be publicly queryable through Secret Network's encrypted compute-query path even though position-level amounts stay private.

branches.summary: Largest normal-status vault; stkd-SCRT is priced by Shade's own staking-derivative oracle (code id 687, label stkd_scrt_oracle_shade_0.1) composing the Band SCRT/USD price with the stkd-SCRT staking contract exchange rate; the composite returned 0.0793 USD, fresh within a minute of the block-26592283 observation.

branches.fallbackBehavior: No alternate oracle provider exists: Shade's tech-stack documentation lists Band Protocol as the live oracle with SupraOracles still under research, and the Oracle Router holds a single default provider (Band Standard Reference Proxy secret1ezamax2vrhjpy92fnujlpwfj2dpredaafss47k). The router's protected-key deviation guard list was empty at block 26592283, so no deviation clamp is currently enforced; an OraclesAdmin can freeze the router via Admin Auth. Band heartbeat for this Secret Network deployment is not published; all Band-backed keys returned sub-minute-fresh updates at the observation time.

Collateral token secret1k6u0cy4feepm6pehnz804zmwakuwdapm69tuc4. max_ltv 0.50, liquidation discount 10%, borrow fee 0%, interest rate 5% (target), collateral_oracle_delay 600s, status "normal", 124 open positions, elastic debt 3,561.2 SILK at block 26592283. Per-position debt and collateral amounts are private Secret Network state (registry returns zeroed position amounts); per-position LTV is exposed only for liquidatable positions.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Permissionless stability-pool liquidation: anyone can query LiquidatablePositions { vault_id } on the vault registry and execute Liquidate { vault_id, position_id } (Shade hackathon reference). The Shade Stability Pool automatically supplies SILK to repay half of the position's outstanding debt; collateral backing the loan is seized at this vault's 10% liquidation discount and distributed to Stability Pool depositors, the liquidation caller receives 10% of liquidation profits, and a 20% protocol share goes to the Shade treasury (per-vault liquidation_fee config read from the registry). No auction window or liquidation delay is documented; execution is atomic in the calling transaction.
branches.backstop: The Shade Stability Pool (secret1wdxqz26acf2e6rsac8007pd53ak7n8tgeqr46w, code id 925 per the SCRT Labs v1.10 proposal) is the only documented liquidation backstop: pooled SILK repays liquidated debt and depositors receive the seized collateral at the vault discount. Its get_pool_info compute query at block 26592283 reported total_silk_deposited of 88,291.3 SILK (epoch 2) against 207,123.4 SILK of aggregate elastic ShadeLend debt across both registries. No insurance fund, protocol bad-debt buyer, or external liquidation backstop is documented in the reviewed sources.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: No global shutdown, settlement, write-off, or bad-debt socialization path is documented in the reviewed sources (Shade docs, hackathon reference, shade-oracle source). The observed containment lever is per-vault governance freeze: the registry reports vault status (normal / frozen / deprecated), and frozen vaults block new borrowing while existing debt remains. Behavior when the Stability Pool holds insufficient SILK to cover a liquidation is not published. On-chain precedent at block 26592283: the frozen WBTC vault carries 37,867.7 SILK of elastic debt against near-zero remaining collateral (collateral elastic 2,097 raw units, about 0.00002097 WBTC) and its LiquidatablePositions query reverts with a divide-by-zero error, so that shortfall currently sits stranded and unsocialized.
